beats: Hear Mother’s hall talk while Maku carries bottles.
Walk Pookie for 100 actual outside steps and return together.
Optionally follow her bark to the pier and call her back; nothing appears in the water.
Choose one familiar household individual; the others stay with Mother.
data.consequences: The pier detour is optional. Returning without Pookie does not complete the walk. Choice preserves the same creature.

description:
Mother gives the child a small freedom before a larger one. Maku’s imperfect help and Pookie’s enthusiasm establish a family that exists before companion selection.

The scene presents preparation and care, not the explanation of arrested childhood.
name: A little walk, then a companion
